runProfile.note: Manual profile runs the full current spam surface for research cleanup and stress-discovery.

decision.note: This batch intentionally stays outside seed-strategies.json. Survivors, if any, require manual review before becoming curated candidates.

modes.scope: BTC-only breakout, mean-reversion, MA reclaim/reject, and volume-shock fade parameter spam.
ETH/SOL spot-candle continuation/fade spam with BTC_RISK_ON/BTC_RISK_OFF direction gating.
Source-inspired grid/DCA/MM claims require a specific source prior and separate inventory/fee controls before testing.
Public funding/basis spam should use linear-perp data and stay separated from spot-candle batches.

candidates.idea: Spam simple BTC volume-confirmed breakouts across 1h/4h to see whether any dumb breakout parameter pocket survives strict gates.
Spam BTC RSI mean-reversion fades with trend-strength caps.
Spam BTC moving-average reclaim/reject continuation variants.
Spam ETH/SOL continuation after moving-average reclaim/reject, but only when BTC regime explicitly agrees with the alt direction.
Spam ETH/SOL RSI fades only when BTC regime permits the fade direction.

survivors.idea: Spam ETH/SOL continuation after moving-average reclaim/reject, but only when BTC regime explicitly agrees with the alt direction.

thesis.mechanism: alt continuation has a better prior when BTC regime aligns first
thesis.expectedBehavior: alt MA reclaim/reject should only count when BTC gate permits the direction
thesis.falsifiableClaim: Reject unless the variant survives sample, expectancy, profit-factor, drawdown, worst-slice, out-of-sample, baseline-lift, and deflated-Sharpe gates.

deflatedSharpeCalibration.note: Research-only proxy: subtracts a trial-count penalty from observed trade Sharpe; useful for rejecting overfit variants, not a full institutional Deflated Sharpe Ratio implementation.

probabilisticSharpeCalibration.label: diagnostic_probabilistic_sharpe_proxy
probabilisticSharpeCalibration.note: Diagnostic-only PSR-style proxy: estimates probability that trade Sharpe exceeds the matched baseline Sharpe while accounting for sample length, skew, and kurtosis; not a survival gate.
